title.orig: 黃鶴樓送孟浩然之廣陵
title.en: At Yellow Crane Tower, Seeing Off Meng Haoran to Guangling
title.zh: 黄鹤楼送孟浩然之广陵

edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource; the variant readings it marks are left out.
edition.zh: 据维基文库，删去其所注异文。

source.name: Wikisource
source.url: https://zh.wikisource.org/wiki/黃鶴樓送孟浩然之廣陵

basis.en: Tang dynasty poem; the author died in 762.

note.en: Li Bai admired Meng Haoran, twelve years his elder, and saw him off down the Yangtze from Wuchang. The poem never names a feeling: it watches the sail until it is gone, then keeps watching the river. Most readers know the third line as 'lost in the blue sky', 碧空; the text shelved here reads 'blue hills', 碧山, and Wikisource records the other as a variant.
note.zh: 李白敬慕年长他十二岁的孟浩然，在武昌黄鹤楼送他顺江东下。诗里没有一个写情绪的字：它目送孤帆直到看不见，然后继续看着江水。大多数读者熟悉的第三句是“孤帆远影碧空尽”；这里收录的文本作“碧山”，维基文库把“空”列为异文。

excerpt.orig: 孤帆遠影碧山盡，唯見長江天際流。
excerpt.en: The far shape of his lone sail is lost where the blue hills end, / and all I see is the long river flowing to the edge of the sky.
excerpt.zh: 孤帆远影碧山尽，唯见长江天际流。
